admin.audit.error.en: Could not load the audit log. Check that the backend is running.

admin.audit.subtitle.en: Every change an admin made, and every blocked attempt to open the admin area.

admin.errors.generic.en: Something went wrong. Please try again.

admin.errors.network.en: Cannot reach the server. Is the backend running?

admin.errors.noAccess.en: No access. This account is not an admin, so you have been signed out.

admin.overview.empty.en: No users yet. Numbers appear here as soon as people sign up.

admin.overview.error.en: Could not load the numbers. Check that the backend is running.

admin.overview.soon.runs.note.en: Counted once job research runs exist (TIQ-16).

admin.privacy.allowedExplain.en: Allowed: every user's profile data may be sent to the AI provider. Use only with a paid AI tier whose privacy terms were verified.

admin.privacy.blockedExplain.en: Blocked: only test accounts (fictional data) can use AI features that send profile data. Real users see a message that the feature is not available yet.

admin.privacy.changeMessage.en: The setting goes from {{from}} to {{to}}. Your reason is saved with your account and the time, and shown in the history and the audit log.

admin.privacy.confirmAllow.en: I confirm KOBANIQ uses a paid AI tier and the privacy requirements have been verified.

admin.privacy.error.en: Could not load the setting. Check that the backend is running.

admin.privacy.reasonHint.en: Required: why the setting is changed (10 to 500 characters).

admin.privacy.statusLabel.en: Sending real users' profile data to the AI

admin.privacy.subtitle.en: Controls whether real users' profile data may be sent to the AI provider (for example to write CVs).

admin.privacy.tooLong.en: The reason can be at most 500 characters.

admin.privacy.tooShort.en: Give a reason of at least 10 characters.

admin.regions.error.en: Could not load the regions. Check that the backend is running.

admin.regions.subtitle.en: City suggestions users see when they filter jobs. One city per line.

admin.regions.tooLong.en: A city name can be at most 60 characters.

admin.sources.badPriority.en: Enter a whole number from 0 to 1000.

admin.sources.blocked.adapter.en: No adapter in the server yet

admin.sources.confirm.disable.en: Switch off {{name}}? Users can no longer choose it, and it is not searched.

admin.sources.confirm.enable.en: Switch on {{name}}? Users can choose it for job research right away.

admin.sources.empty.en: No job sources yet. The team adds a source as an adapter in the server plus a database record.

admin.sources.error.en: Could not load the job sources. Check that the backend is running.

admin.sources.priorityLabel.en: Order in the app (0–1000, lower first)

admin.sources.subtitle.en: Where job research looks for jobs. A source can only be switched on after its terms were checked and the server has an adapter for it.

admin.users.confirm.delete.en: Delete {{email}} for good? This cannot be undone.

admin.users.confirm.makeAdmin.en: Make {{email}} an admin? They get full access to this dashboard.

admin.users.confirm.makeUser.en: Make {{email}} a normal user? They lose access to this dashboard.

admin.users.confirm.reactivate.en: Reactivate {{email}}? They can log in again.

admin.users.confirm.suspend.en: Suspend {{email}}? They are signed out on every device and cannot log in until reactivated.

admin.users.error.en: Could not load users. Check that the backend is running.

admin.users.testAccountHint.en: Test accounts hold fictional data and may use AI features that send profile data while AI privacy is Blocked.

admin.users.testDialogOff.en: Remove the test account mark from {{email}}? AI features that send profile data then follow the AI privacy setting.

admin.users.testDialogOn.en: Mark {{email}} as a test account? Use only for accounts that hold fictional data.

admin.users.testOff.en: {{email}} is no longer a test account.

admin.users.you.en: This is your own account. Another admin must change it.

mobile.auth.errors.codeInvalid.en: Enter the 6-digit code from the email.

mobile.auth.errors.emailTaken.en: An account with this email already exists. Log in instead.

mobile.auth.errors.generic.en: Something went wrong. Please try again.

mobile.auth.errors.invalidCode.en: The code is wrong or has expired. Ask for a new one.

mobile.auth.errors.network.en: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet connection.

mobile.auth.errors.suspended.en: This account is suspended. Contact support.

mobile.auth.errors.tooManyAttempts.en: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one.

mobile.auth.forgot.subtitle.en: Enter your email. If it has a KOBANIQ account, we'll send a code to reset your password.

mobile.auth.language.subtitle.en: You can change it any time in Settings.

mobile.auth.later.google.en: Google sign-in arrives in a later update.

mobile.auth.login.passwordChanged.en: Your password was changed. Log in with your new password.

mobile.auth.login.subtitle.en: Log in to see your matches and continue your assessments.

mobile.auth.onboarding.cv.body.en: Build a CV for each job from your real profile, in English or Somali. Nothing is invented, and you approve it before you export.

mobile.auth.onboarding.jobs.body.en: Search the job sources you choose in Somaliland, Somalia and remote. Every match tells you why it fits — and which skills are missing.

mobile.auth.onboarding.jobs.explanation.en: Matches 4 of 5 required skills. Missing: GraphQL.

mobile.auth.onboarding.skills.body.en: Take short adaptive quizzes to verify your skills — always optional. Results measure knowledge, not proof of real-world experience.

mobile.auth.placeholder.body.en: This screen is built in the next part of this task.

mobile.auth.reset.subtitle.en: Enter the code we sent to {{email}} and your new password.

mobile.auth.verify.codeSent.en: A new code is on its way. Check your inbox and spam folder.

mobile.auth.verify.resendIn.en: You can ask for a new code in {{seconds}} s

mobile.auth.verify.subtitle.en: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Enter it to confirm your email.

mobile.auth.welcome.body.en: AI-powered career intelligence: verify what you know, discover real jobs that fit, and build tailored CVs.

mobile.auth.welcome.tagline.en:
Know Your Skills.
Find Your Opportunity.

mobile.home.cvs.empty.en: No CVs yet. Your CVs will appear here.

mobile.home.error.generic.en: Your overview could not be loaded. Please try again.

mobile.home.error.network.en: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet connection.

mobile.home.profileCard.body.en: A complete profile gives better CVs and job matches.

mobile.home.schedule.empty.en: No scheduled search. You can let KOBANIQ search for jobs on a schedule later.

mobile.home.skillCard.empty.en: No skills yet. Add your skills, then take a short test to show employers what you really know.

mobile.home.skillCard.someSelf_one.en: {{count}} skill is self-reported. A short optional quiz can confirm it.

mobile.home.skillCard.someSelf_other.en: {{count}} skills are self-reported. A short optional quiz can confirm them.

mobile.home.topMatch.empty.en: No job matches yet. Start a job search to see jobs that fit you.

mobile.preview.job.explanation.en: Matches 4 of 5 required skills: React Native, TypeScript, Git, REST APIs.

mobile.profile.deleteConfirm.en: Delete this entry? This cannot be undone.

mobile.profile.hints.contactEmail.en: Shown on your CVs. Your login email does not change.

mobile.profile.hints.endDate.en: Leave empty if you still work here

mobile.profile.itemGone.en: This entry no longer exists. Go back to see your list.

mobile.profile.languageError.generic.en: The language changed on this phone, but it could not be saved to your account. Please choose it again.

mobile.profile.languageError.network.en: The language changed on this phone, but it could not be saved to your account. Check your internet connection and choose it again.

mobile.profile.languageHint.en: The app and messages from KOBANIQ use this language on all your devices.

mobile.profile.loadError.en: Your profile could not be loaded. Check your internet connection and try again.

mobile.profile.personalHint.en: Employers see this on your CVs. Only you can see and change it.

mobile.profile.sectionHints.languages.en: Languages you speak and how well.

mobile.profile.sectionHints.preferences.en: What kind of job you are looking for. Job research uses this.

mobile.profile.sectionHints.projects.en: Things you built or worked on.

mobile.skills.emptyBody.en: Add the skills you have and rate them yourself. Later, a short optional quiz can confirm them.

mobile.skills.formHint.en: This is your own rating. A quiz can confirm it later; your rating stays as you set it.

mobile.skills.loadError.en: Your skills could not be loaded. Check your internet connection and try again.

mobile.skills.onlyQuiz.en: Only a quiz changes the assessed level. It measures knowledge, not work experience.

mobile.skills.suggestBody.en: A short quiz can confirm your level. It is always optional. Quizzes come in an upcoming update.

mobile.soon.cv.body.en: Soon you can paste a job description and create a CV for that job from your profile, in English or Somali.

mobile.soon.jobs.body.en: Soon you can choose regions and job sources in Somaliland and Somalia and get jobs that match you, each with an explanation.

mobile.soon.reports.body.en: Reports on your CVs, tests and job searches appear once you start using those features.

server.email.resetPassword.body.en:
Hello,

Your KOBANIQ password reset code is: {{code}}

Enter it in the app to choose a new password. The code works for {{minutes}} minutes.

If you did not ask to reset your password, you can ignore this email; your password stays the same.

KOBANIQ

server.email.verifyEmail.body.en:
Hello,

Your KOBANIQ verification code is: {{code}}

Enter it in the app to confirm your email. The code works for {{minutes}} minutes.

If you did not create a KOBANIQ account, you can ignore this email.

KOBANIQ

server.errors.AI_BAD_OUTPUT.en: The AI could not give a usable answer. Please try again

server.errors.AI_LIMIT_REACHED.en: You have used the AI features a lot in the last hour. Please try again later

server.errors.AI_NOT_CONFIGURED.en: The AI service is not set up yet. Please try again later

server.errors.AI_PERSONAL_DATA_BLOCKED.en: Creating CVs with AI is not available yet. KOBANIQ uses a free AI service during development, which must not receive personal data

server.errors.AI_QUOTA_REACHED.en: The free AI limit has been reached for now. Please try again later

server.errors.AI_TIMEOUT.en: The AI took too long to answer. Please try again

server.errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE.en: The AI service is not available right now. Please try again later

server.errors.CANNOT_CHANGE_SELF.en: You cannot change your own account here

server.errors.CV_CONTACT_EMAIL_REQUIRED.en: Add the email address to show on your CVs (Profile → Personal info) before creating a CV

server.errors.CV_GENERATION_IN_PROGRESS.en: This CV is already being created. Try again in a moment

server.errors.CV_LIMIT_REACHED.en: You have the most CVs allowed. Delete some first

server.errors.EMAIL_TAKEN.en: An account with this email already exists

server.errors.FORBIDDEN.en: You do not have access to this page

server.errors.INVALID_CODE.en: The code is wrong or has expired. Ask for a new one

server.errors.INVALID_JSON.en: Request body is not valid JSON

server.errors.INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN.en: Refresh token is invalid or expired

server.errors.JD_LIMIT_REACHED.en: You have saved the most job descriptions allowed. Delete one first

server.errors.LAST_ADMIN.en: At least one active admin must remain

server.errors.NOT_A_JOB_DESCRIPTION.en: This does not look like a job description. Paste or upload a job advertisement

server.errors.NO_SOURCES_SELECTED.en: Choose at least one job source

server.errors.PROFILE_INCOMPLETE.en: Add your experience, education or skills to your profile before creating a CV

server.errors.PROFILE_ITEM_NOT_FOUND.en: This profile entry was not found

server.errors.PROFILE_SECTION_FULL.en: This section is full. Remove an entry before adding a new one

server.errors.REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED.en: This session was ended for safety. Please log in again

server.errors.SETTING_UNCHANGED.en: The setting already has this value

server.errors.SKILLS_FULL.en: You have the most skills allowed. Remove one first

server.errors.SKILL_EXISTS.en: You already have this skill. Edit it instead

server.errors.SOURCE_ADAPTER_MISSING.en: This source can't be enabled because the server has no adapter for it yet

server.errors.SOURCE_NOT_AVAILABLE.en: One or more of the chosen sources are not available. Refresh the list and try again

server.errors.SOURCE_TERMS_NOT_CHECKED.en: This source can't be enabled until its terms have been checked

server.errors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS.en: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one

server.validation.ageConfirmRequired.en: Confirm that you are 18 or older

server.validation.auditActionInvalid.en: Must be one of the audit actions

server.validation.citiesInvalid.en: Must be a list of up to 100 city names (each up to 60 characters)

server.validation.codeInvalid.en: Enter the 6-digit code from the email

server.validation.cvLanguageRequired.en: Choose the CV language: English or Somali

server.validation.dateOrderInvalid.en: The end cannot be before the start

server.validation.employerTypeInvalid.en: Must be one of the employer types

server.validation.fieldNotEditable.en: This field cannot be changed here

server.validation.filtersInvalid.en: Filters must be short lists of words, a city name and employer types

server.validation.jdTextLength.en: The job description must be between 50 and 20,000 characters

server.validation.jdTextOrPdf.en: Paste the job description text or upload a PDF (one of the two)

server.validation.listInvalid.en: Must be a short list of valid entries

server.validation.monthInvalid.en: Use year and month, for example 2024-09

server.validation.numberInvalid.en: Enter a whole number in the allowed range

server.validation.passwordTooLong.en: Password must be at most {{max}} characters

server.validation.passwordTooShort.en: Password must be at least {{min}} characters

server.validation.pdfInvalid.en: This is not a valid PDF file

server.validation.pdfTooLarge.en: The PDF can be at most 5 MB

server.validation.periodInvalid.en: Must be day, week, month or year
